scientific_integrity: Finite integer-cyclotomic exhaustive proof with independent permutation-expansion check; no external certification or independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact only on F_5^2 for three-point row and frequency sets, with unnormalized Fourier transform. Determinant volume is not the Riesz ratio. An older equivalent minor table has not been ruled out. No infinite-family theorem claimed.
title: Exact three-point Fourier determinant spectrum on the five-by-five affine plane
